Order:

This Contempt Case is filed for willful violation of the orders passed by this Court in Crl.P.No.861 of 2025 on 30.01.2025, wherein this Court passed the following order:
"In the result, the Criminal Petition is allowed.

The proceedings against the petitioners herein/A3 & A4 in Crime No.194 of 2024 dated 08.07.2024 on the file of Disha IPS, Visakhapatnam for the offences punishable under Section 498A of IPC and Section 3 of the Dowry Prohibition Act is hereby quashed."

2. Today, when the matter came up for hearing, learned counsel for the petitioners stated that, in pursuance of the orders passed by this Court on 30.01.2025, the names of the petitioners herein,
who were shown as A3 and A4 in Crime No.194 of 2024 dated 08.07.2024 on the file of Disha IPS,
Visakhapatnam for the offences punishable under Section 498A of IPC and Section 3 of the Dowry Prohibition Act, were deleted from the charge sheet and, as such, requested this Court to close the contempt case.
3.
Accordingly, the contempt case is closed.
As a sequel, miscellaneous applications, pending, if any, shall also stand closed.
